title: Eat Copper!
description: Simple mod that allows you to Eat copper
body:
# Eat Copper!
Have you ever wanted to eat copper? Well, now you can! :D

## Features

Makes every Copper block/item edible its an High-tier **"Super Food"** with high nutrition values to keep you exploring

### Mod made by **_MCT_**

**_Note: Please do not attempt to eat copper in real life. This is for Minecraft only!_**
